s.note: Devils on horseback and cheese puffs. Plan a reception, wrong hors d'oeuvres.
s.how: Stuff each date with a little blue cheese and wrap tightly in half a rasher. Boil the water and butter, tip in the flour and beat until it comes away from the pan. Cool slightly, beat in the eggs one at a time, then the gruyere and mustard. Pipe or spoon the dough into small balls on a lined tray. Bake the puffs and the dates at 200C until the puffs are risen and golden and the bacon is crisp.

s.note: Light tempura prawns, tentsuyu dipping sauce. Tug begs Japan not to make such good cars.
s.how: Warm the dashi, soy and mirin together for the dipping sauce, then cool. Score the underside of each prawn so it stays straight. Stir the yolk and soda water, then flick in the flours and mix with chopsticks, leaving it lumpy. Dip the prawns and fry at 180C in small batches until pale gold and crisp. Serve at once with the sauce and grated daikon.

m.note: Lemon and garlic roast chicken, pan gravy. Topper fires a chicken from his bow.
m.how: Rub the chicken with butter and salt and stuff it with the lemon, garlic and thyme. Toss the potatoes in oil and salt around the bird in a roasting tin. Roast at 200C until the juices run clear and the potatoes are golden. Rest the chicken, then stir the flour into the pan juices and whisk in the stock to make gravy. Carve and serve with the potatoes and gravy.

m.n: Topper and Ramada's spaghetti and meatballs
m.note: Beef and pork meatballs, slow tomato sauce. Topper and Ramada share one strand.
m.how: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the mince, egg, parmesan, a third of the garlic and salt and roll into 20 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil and set aside. Soften the remaining garlic in the pan, add the tomatoes and simmer, then return the meatballs and cook gently. Boil the spaghetti until al dente and toss with some sauce. Serve topped with meatballs, basil and parmesan.

w.note: Frozen honey and pistachio cream, rose syrup. Benson freezes Saddam with an extinguisher.
w.how: Whisk the yolks with half the sugar and the honey until pale and thick. Whip the cream to soft peaks, and in a clean bowl whisk the whites with the remaining sugar to firm peaks. Fold the cream, then the whites and most of the pistachios, into the yolks and spoon into a lined loaf tin. Freeze overnight. Boil the sugar and water for the syrup, cool and stir in the rosewater. Slice, drizzle with rose syrup and scatter with the remaining pistachios.

d.note: Strong spiced black tea, condensed milk, ice. Topper retires to a village in Thailand.
d.how: Steep the tea, star anise and cinnamon in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then strain. Stir in the condensed milk and chill. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses and float the evaporated milk on top.
